scope.interaction: open the runtime permission menu and dismiss it outside without changing the permission

productLoss: Web uses a Select primitive that dismisses outside the popup, while the Lynx runtime permission menu was only an absolute list with no outside interaction surface.
The Lynx menu could be closed only by choosing a permission or tapping the trigger again.
The fix adds a full-window transparent dismiss layer, lifts the runtime control island above it, and keeps the menu above the layer.
classification.evidenceBoundary: This exact-bundle run verifies Native outside dismissal and unchanged permission state. It does not claim menu material or typography parity.

dismiss.input: DevTool Input.emulateTouchFromMouseEvent on measured runtime trigger and dismiss layer
dismiss.label: Full access

activeItem.text: Full access Allow commands and edits without prompts.

validation.build: Lynx production build passed with existing unsupported-property and import.meta warnings

remainingRisk: Runtime permission menu material, typography, and row geometry are not compared to Web in this behavior-only slice.
Keyboard Escape dismissal remains pending a physical keyboard or authorized Computer Use session.
Thinking and effort controls remain a separate user-reported scope.
